priorities.summary: An authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service lets an attacker with network access to vCenter gain administrator access without any credentials. Broadcom disclosed it on 19 November 2026 after Google's Mandiant found it exploited as a zero-day since early September; patches are available and no workaround exists.
priorities.plain: VMware vCenter Server lets an unauthenticated network attacker take full administrator control; patch vCenter to the fixed release immediately.

priorities.summary: Deserializing a crafted SOAP fault lets an unauthenticated remote attacker load and instantiate arbitrary classes on the server, leading to remote code execution. Axis 1.x is end-of-life with no fix release planned, and CISA added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 18 November 2026 after exploitation was detected against Confluence and N-central.
priorities.plain: Apache Axis 1.x lets a remote attacker with no login run code on the server; migrate off the end-of-life software now.

priorities.summary: A path-traversal flaw in Etherpad's pre-authentication static-asset handler lets a remote attacker with no credentials read any file available to the Etherpad process. Leaked configuration or environment secrets can then expose administrator credentials and lead to full server compromise; fixed in Etherpad 3.3.3.
priorities.plain: Etherpad lets anyone on the internet read any file the server can see; upgrade to Etherpad 3.3.3 immediately.

model.name: Gemini 4 Neon
model.summary: Google's new mid-tier Gemini 4 model brings frontier-level reasoning to complex coding, knowledge work and science tasks with fast end-to-end completion, sitting between the flagship Carbon and the everyday Hydrogen. It is rolling out now in the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, the Gemini app and Antigravity.
model.plain: Google's new mid-tier AI model handles demanding coding, analysis and research work quickly, giving teams frontier-level results for everyday professional tasks.
